item.title: 2 protesters pepper sprayed outside SF ICE office; city leaders prepare for planned weekend protest
item.description: There were tense moments Friday outside an ICE office in San Francisco after the shooting of Renee Good in Minneapolis; protesters calling for the agent who shot Good to be charged with murder.

item.title: 'Big red spot': Bay Area 90-year-old reports skin irritation where she wears Apple Watch
item.description: Ninety-year-old Anita De Marais of San Leandro, who wore her Apple Watch "religiously," had to take it off when a red spot appeared on her wrist that lasted a month, but it's unclear what caused the irritation.

item.title: Indiana, Miami to face off in College Football Playoff final matchup that once seemed impossible
item.description: It looked improbable two months ago. Two years ago - impossible. But against the odds, Miami and Indiana have a date in the College Football Playoff final - a first-of-its-kind matchup on Jan. 19.

item.title: Bay Area celebrity chef facing federal charges after allegedly robbing 3 SF banks
item.description: Bay Area celebrity chef Valentino Luchin is facing federal indictment charges after allegedly robbing three banks in San Francisco.

item.title: San Jose police ask for public's help identifying suspect in beloved bakery assault
item.description: Video of the incident at San Jose's Peters Bakery has gone viral, but weeks have gone by with no leads. Customers are frustrated that the attacker still hasn't been found. Now police are asking for the public's help.

item.title: Veteran actor T.K. Carter, known for 'The Thing' and 'Punky Brewster,' dies at 69
item.description: Carter was declared dead Friday evening after deputies responded to a call regarding an unresponsive male in Duarte, California, according to the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Cold temperatures expected into morning
item.description: The next seven days will bring mostly sunny skies with a slightly milder range of temperatures developing by midweek.

item.title: Suspect arrested after 3 people stabbed near 16th and Mission BART station in SF, police say
item.description: Police responded to reports of multiple stab victims at 16th and Mission in San Francisco, right next to the BART station on Saturday. A suspect has been arrested.

item.title: Remembering John Beam: Celebration of life held for legendary Oakland coach
item.description: A celebration of life was held for legendary Oakland coach John Beam, who tragically died in November. His celebration can be watched here on ABC7.

item.title: Bob Weir, founding member of the Grateful Dead and Bay Area native, dies at 78
item.description: Grateful Dead founding member and guitarist Bob Weir has died at age 78, a post on his Instagram account confirmed Saturday.
